meals.name: Ground Turkey Teriyaki Stir Fry
ings: 3 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 cup water divided
steps: Sauce: Combine ¾ cup water, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, honey, and brown sugar in saucepan over medium. Bring to low boil. Whisk remaining water with cornstarch; stir in slowly until thickened. Add orange zest. Set aside.
Heat sesame oil in wok or skillet over medium-high. Sauté onion until softened. Add turkey; cook until fully cooked, 7–10 min.
Add broccoli and carrots; cook until tender.
Reduce heat to low; stir in teriyaki sauce. Simmer a few minutes. Serve over rice.
meals.label: Meal A

meals.name: Sheet Pan Honey Mustard Chicken with Potatoes & Green Beans
ings: 1 tbsp whole grain mustard (or extra Dijon)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Whisk together all honey mustard sauce ingredients in a bowl. Set aside.
Toss halved baby potatoes with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Spread on a large sheet pan in a single layer. Roast 15 minutes.

Season chicken thighs all over with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Remove pan from oven. Push potatoes to the sides and add chicken thighs skin-side up in the center. Brush generously with honey mustard sauce.
Return to oven and roast 15 more minutes.
Add green beans to the pan, tossing with any remaining sauce and pan juices. Roast 12–15 more minutes until chicken reaches 165°F and skin is golden and caramelized.
Rest chicken 5 minutes. Drizzle pan juices over everything before serving.
meals.note: 💡 The staggered timing — potatoes first, then chicken, then green beans — is the key to everything cooking perfectly together. Don't crowd the pan.
meals.label: Meal B

meals.name: Butternut Squash Ravioli with Brown Butter Sage
ings: ¼ tsp fresh cracked black pepper
Grated pecorino or Parmesan for serving
steps: Boil ravioli per package. Drain al dente; do not rinse.

Melt butter in skillet over medium, stirring until it bubbles, then froths. Add sage — it will fry in the butter. Cook until froth subsides and brown bits form. Remove from heat. Transfer sage to paper towel.
Return pan to medium-low. Whisk in cream. Simmer 1–2 min, add salt and pepper.
Add ravioli to sauce and toss. Serve with Parmesan and crispy sage.
meals.note: 💡 Total butter browning time: 4–5 minutes. Watch carefully — it goes from golden to burnt quickly.
meals.label: Meal C
